classes.purpose: Establish the accounting meaning, perimeter, mappings, relationships, reconciliation posture, and review status needed to prepare financial-analysis evidence
classes.content: User instructions; trial balances, general ledgers, P&L tables, receivables, payables, inventory, revenue and customer files; source identities and hashes; dataset and relationship contracts; reviewed crosswalks; calculation parameters; reconciliation results; prepared tables; replay evidence; limitations and review decisions

security_controls.control: The workflow validates canonical hashes for the package, dataset, relationship, crosswalk, request, reconciliation, and prepared-evidence contracts and fails when a digest is stale or a reference does not close.
Many-to-many and judgmental identity or classification mappings require an explicit reviewed crosswalk receipt rather than silent label-based inference.
The prepared-evidence manifest and its contract audit are forced to report_ready=false so deterministic preparation cannot be presented as professional approval.
